title: Terrain route level-of-detail
summary: The complete route remains continuous at world and continent zoom. As the user zooms into local terrain, global backbone and unselected long-haul flights fade away so they no longer cut across the map; local corridors and the selected leg stay prominent.

title: Continuous terrain route backbone
summary: Terrain now keeps a continuous chapter-colored route backbone visible across every active leg, with stronger local ground/ferry corridors and the selected leg layered above it.

title: Continuous terrain route rendering
summary: Flight legs now remain continuous at every zoom level. Visual hierarchy uses opacity and stroke weight instead of dashed or disappearing connectors, preserving the impression of one uninterrupted world route.

title: Terrain route hierarchy refined
summary: All route now renders all chapters without an accidental selected-chapter emphasis. Long unselected flight connectors fade out at close terrain zoom while ground, rail and ferry corridors remain readable.

title: Ground and ferry corridor geometry expanded
summary: Terrain now uses curated corridor-level waypoints for 84 route legs, including North/Central America, South America, Asia, Africa, Gulf/Levant and Europe II.

title: Release 2 foundations
summary: Runtime hardening, English public UI, Story camera stabilization, Terrain globe and scalable journey intelligence foundations.

title: Terrain chapter focus
summary: Chapter selection now recenters the terrain globe on the selected route region instead of only recoloring the route.

title: Plan vs Actual prepared
summary: Public live-progress schema, statistics, journal and route change history are ready before departure.
